name: What causes interior water damage most often in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: What causes interior water damage most often in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, winter pipe bursts and rapid spring snowmelt are primary culprits behind indoor water damage. Freezing temperatures can rupture copper or PEX plumbing lines in exterior walls or unheated crawl spaces, soaking basements and main-floor ceilings. During spring, heavy, wet Colorado snow melting on roofs can back up beneath eaves and cause attic leaks. When rebuilding these spaces in Denver, Centennial, or Parker, contractors must ensure framing cavities are completely dry and install proper insulation before hanging new drywall to prevent repeat freeze events.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frozen plumbing lines during winter cold snaps and rapid spring snowmelt leaks are the most common causes across Denver, Centennial, and surrounding communities.
